headword: {飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}
gloss: run of holidays broken up by workdays

definitions.gloss: series of holidays with workdays in between
definitions.explanation: A stretch of the calendar in which public holidays fall close together but are separated by one or two ordinary workdays, so the days off do not form one continuous break. Literally 'stepping-stone consecutive holidays'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}だ。
examples.english: This year the holidays are broken up by workdays.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{遠出|とおで}→遠出：14430_toode⟧はしない。
examples.english: Since the holidays are split up by workdays, I won't take a long trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れば→取る：00565_toru⟧、{飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}{連休|れんきゅう}→大型連休：14847_oogatarenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you take the weekday in between off, the scattered holidays turn into one long break.

notes:
Named after ⟦{飛|と}び{石|いし}→飛び石：29881_tobiishi⟧ (stepping stones), which are set apart from one another. The image is of days off dotted across the calendar with workdays between them, unlike a ⟦{大型|おおがた}{連休|れんきゅう}→大型連休：14847_oogatarenkyuu⟧ (one long continuous holiday).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fall as scattered holidays
- ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧: the workday(s) in between

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}{連休|れんきゅう}→大型連休：14847_oogatarenkyuu⟧: a long, continuous run of consecutive holidays — the opposite situation
